race.comment: SHALHAVMUSIK (9) brings the most reliable recent profile, having backed up a Gawler second with a determined win there over 1516m, beating Taupo Tiger by just under a length after settling midfield. Her record at this track and distance is solid, and she looks well placed to hold that form. FLYING ACE (3) is the clear danger third-up, with both runs this campaign better than the bare numbers after racing wide two back and keenly last start when fifth, beaten just over two lengths. IMMORTAL SPIRIT (5) is in winning form after scores at Balaklava and Halidon, though he rises from BM52 and country grade into a harder assignment, so his proven 1400m record becomes important. BLACK SEA (7) resumes off two trials, including a latest third at Murray Bridge, and can run well fresh.
